Adristyrannus.description: A phytophagous bug that feeds on foliage and tender shoots, causing stippling and distortion. Localised outbreaks can defoliate young plants.
Adristyrannus.ipm: Remove weed hosts, encourage generalist predators, and scout tender shoots early.

Aleurocanthus spiniferus.description: A whitefly of citrus and other trees. Nymphs excrete honeydew that fuels sooty mould, reducing photosynthesis; it is a regulated quarantine pest in many regions.
Aleurocanthus spiniferus.ipm: Use yellow sticky traps, conserve Encarsia/Eretmocerus parasitoids, prune dense canopy.

Ampelophaga.description: Large caterpillars that defoliate grapevine and related hosts. A few larvae can strip significant leaf area quickly during outbreaks.
Ampelophaga.ipm: Hand-pick larvae on small plots; apply Bacillus thuringiensis while larvae are young.

Aphis citricola Vander Goot.description: A colonising aphid on citrus and pome fruit. Feeds on new growth, curls leaves, and transmits plant viruses; honeydew promotes sooty mould.
Aphis citricola Vander Goot.ipm: Protect ladybird beetles and lacewings; avoid excess nitrogen that flushes soft growth.

Apolygus lucorum.description: A highly mobile mirid that punctures buds, flowers, and fruit of cotton, fruit, and vegetables, causing shedding and deformed produce; a major pest across its range.
Apolygus lucorum.ipm: Monitor with sweep nets at flowering; manage border weed hosts that harbour adults.

alfalfa plant bug.description: Feeds on alfalfa buds and growing tips, reducing seed set and forage quality during bloom.
alfalfa plant bug.ipm: Time cutting to disrupt nymphs; sweep-net scout before bloom and treat on threshold.

alfalfa seed chalcid.description: Larvae develop inside developing alfalfa seeds, hollowing them out and directly cutting seed yield. Damage is hidden until seeds are inspected.
alfalfa seed chalcid.ipm: Destroy volunteer/wild alfalfa, harvest promptly, and sanitise infested seed screenings.

alfalfa weevil.description: Larvae skeletonise alfalfa leaves in the first cutting, causing the classic "frosted" field appearance and major forage loss in spring.
alfalfa weevil.ipm: Early cutting often controls larvae; conserve the parasitoid Bathyplectes.

aphids.description: Soft-bodied colonising insects that suck sap, curl leaves, excrete honeydew, and transmit many plant viruses. Reproduce explosively under warm conditions.
aphids.ipm: Favour ladybirds/lacewings/parasitic wasps; a strong water spray dislodges light colonies.
